description:
The Helium Cruiser XL has developed a strong following for good reason. Built around our proven aftermarket Helium Cruiser frame and equipped with a full pro-level build kit, this 24"" race machine delivers the performance and reliability cruiser riders demand.
Featuring forged dropouts, our aftermarket Argon Pro rims, and quality components from Promax and Tioga, every detail has been chosen with racing in mind. Whether you're chasing podiums or simply enjoying the unique feel of cruiser racing, the Helium Cruiser XL is built to perform.

FRAME: hydroformed 6061-T6 alloy frame, tapered headtube, forged dropouts, with int. chaintensioners

STEM: ARISE "XENON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 53mm, cold forged/cnc alloy

PROMAX "TX-131" brake, rear
PROMAX "XL-373" brake lever, rear
KMC "Z6" chain, 1/2" x 3/32"
ARISE "XENON PRO" sprocket, 41T, alloy
RADIO RACELINE driver, 16T, 1/2"- 3/32", sealed cassette
ARISE, Xenon Pro, 2pc crank, cold forged/cnc, alloy, 180mm length, 24mm spindle
crmo fork, 1-1/8" butted steerer, crmo fork legs, 30mm offset
RADIO RACELINE "XENON" grips, diamond knurling, clamp on grip, 139mm length
4130 crmo bar, seamless
RADIO RACELINE "PRO" integrated headset, sealed, threadless, 1-1/8" - 1.5", including fork crown race 1.5"-1 1/8" converter
